orders.name: folders first, then files, each by name
the letters A to Z read as a to z, then by code units
punctuation and digits by their code units
letters past Z by their code units, after z
a surrogate pair by its code units, before a letter past it
a decomposed accent apart from the composed one
a folder and a file of one name, the folder first

views.name: an image by its extension, whatever its bytes
an SVG is an image, though it is text
a name with no extension as text
a dot file has no extension
a file named .md alone is text, not markdown
emoji and CRLF stay as written
bytes that aren't UTF-8 are binary
a sequence cut short is binary

delimited.name: quotes hold separators, line breaks and doubled quotes
one row with no line end
one row with a line end
a last field empty before a line end
a quote inside a field is kept
text after a closing quote joins the field
a quote never closed runs to the end
a comma in a TSV is text

lines.name: a last LF ends the file
CRLF keeps its CR on each line
CR alone is no line end

runners.words: runner-1, the runner Lab lives on
The runner the project lives on

trees.name: folders first, each by name, a folder holding one folder read as one row
names in the same order in every locale
two folders Swift would take as one, a composed accent and a decomposed one
a lone folder at the top merges with the folder it holds, the root never
a folder's newest touch, a file only a merge changed counting none
open from the top while the rows fit, the biggest closed
